sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the prior repairs: retain nonlinear-method applicability, calculation-case ownership, all six canonical operand paths with their declared owners, unitless margin quantities, millimetre deformation/dimension quantities, the acceptance evidence, and the satisfied assessment result. The ship shape currently checks bucklingResponse and plasticDeformation only as unassociated ship facts; it does not associate those required capture outputs with the applicable nonlinear calculation case or analysis structure. Locate and use a canonical relationship/path for that association rather than inventing a term, while keeping bucklingResponse and plasticDeformation on their authoritative ship owner.
